Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: You shall not sacrifice to God your Lord an ox or a sheep in which there is a blemish — of the sort of shameful matters that God your Lord abhors.
translations.2: And if there be found among you, in any of your towns which God your Lord is giving you, a man or a woman who has done evil before God your Lord and transgressed His covenant —
translations.3: and went and worshipped other objects of worship and bowed down to them, or to the sun or to the moon, or to the rest of the stars of the sky, which I have not permitted to him —
translations.4: then when you are informed of that, hear it out and examine it well; and if the matter is true and established, that this abhorrent thing has been done among you,
translations.5: you shall bring out that man, or that woman, who did this wicked thing, to your localities — the man alone, or that woman alone — and you shall stone them with stones until they die.
translations.6: By the word of two witnesses or three shall the one to be put to death be put to death; he shall not be put to death by the word of one witness alone.
translations.7: And the hands of the witnesses shall strike him first to put him to death, and the hands of the rest of the people last. And purge those who do evil from your midst.
translations.8: And when a matter of judgments is obscure to you — between blood and blood, between ruling and ruling, between affliction and affliction — matters of disputes in your localities, then arise and go up to the place which God your Lord shall choose.
translations.9: And go to the Levitical imāms and to the judge who holds office in that time, and seek from them the ruling of that judgment; they shall issue a legal opinion to you.
translations.10: And act according to the matter upon which they issue a legal opinion for you, from that place which God shall choose; and take care to do according to all that they direct you.
translations.11: And according to the guidance they direct you, and the ruling they pronounce to you, you shall do; you shall not deviate from the matter upon which they issue their legal opinion — neither right nor left.
translations.12: And any man who acts with insolence and will not accept from the imām who stands there to serve God your Lord, or from the judge — that man shall be put to death; and purge those who do evil from among Israel.
translations.13: And the rest of the people shall hear and be afraid, and shall not act insolently likewise.
translations.14: And when you enter the land which God your Lord is giving you, and you possess it and settle in it, and you say: 'I will appoint over me a king, like the rest of the nations that are around me' —
translations.15: it is permitted that you appoint over yourself a king whom God your Lord shall choose; and the king whom you appoint shall be from among your brothers; you may not appoint over yourself a foreign man who is not your brother.
translations.16: Only he shall not accumulate for himself many horses, lest he return the people to Egypt to acquire many horses — and God has already said to you: 'You shall not again return by that road, ever.'
translations.17: And he shall not accumulate for himself many women, lest his heart go astray; and silver and gold he shall not accumulate for himself greatly.
translations.18: And when he sits upon the throne of his kingship, he shall have copied out for himself a copy of this Torah in a book, from the presence of the Levitical imāms.
translations.19: It shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear God his Lord, and observe all the words of this Torah and these ordinances, to act by them —
translations.20: so that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and so that he not deviate from the law to the right or to the left, in order that his days be prolonged over his kingdom — he and his sons among the sons of Israel.
